title: Sukha Singh Accepts the Amritsar Challenge

blocks.text: The Mughal challenge at Amritsar is designed to shame the Khalsa in public by implying that no Singh dares approach the sacred pool under guard. After the Panth hears the taunt in silence, Sukha Singh steps forward and declares that he would bathe in the broad daylight rather than creep in secretly at night.

His answer matters because it turns the contest from military bravado into open religious defiance. He announces that, with the Guru's grace, he will enter the guarded place plainly and show that fear cannot regulate Sikh devotion.
The page closes with practical preparation for the exploit. Sukha Singh adopts a disguise and rides toward Amritsar, combining daring, planning, and faith in a single deliberate act.
